test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The banner was trimmed with a golden **fringe**.

options.text: The tailor added a silk fringe to the curtain.
The rope had a loose fringe at the end.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fringe"** in the given statement refers to a decorative edge of material, often made of threads or strips, used to adorn clothing or fabrics. (झालर)
 
 
• **Example: **The banner was trimmed with a golden fringe.
 
 
• In Option 2, **"fringe"** refers to the supplementary benefits provided to employees in addition to their regular salary, such as bonuses, insurance, etc. (अतिरिक्त लाभ)
 
 
• **Example: **The economist discussed fringe benefits like health insurance and annual bonuses.
 
 
• Hence, the word **"fringe"** in Option 2 is used as a homonym, having a different meaning than its usage in the given statement.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: **The tailor added a silk fringe to the curtain. (झालर)
 
 
• **Example: **The tailor added a silk fringe to give the curtain a more elegant look.
 
 
• **Option 3: **The rope had a loose fringe at the end. (झालर)
 
 
• **Example: **The old rope had a loose fringe at its frayed end.
 
 
• **Option 4: **The painting showed fringe patterns. (झालर जैसा)
 
 
• **Example: **The artist skillfully painted fringe patterns on the edges of the artwork.
